    If the answer was "Click", wouldn't "Photograph" or "Record" be a "Yes" or "On the right track"?
    If the answer is "Click", "Photograph" is a *result* of clicking, but it's not the same as "Clicking".
    However, in Concept, "Yes: [guess]" means the guess is on the right track.
    If the answer is "Click" and the guess was "Photograph", the clue-giver would likely say "Yes: Photograph" or "No".
    If the clue-giver said "No" to "Photograph", it's unlikely the answer is "Click".
